newsitem.title: ESTONIA: NOMURA TO TAKE ESTONIAN SHIPPING TO BOURSE.
newsitem.headline: NOMURA TO TAKE ESTONIAN SHIPPING TO BOURSE.

text.p: Nomura International said on Thursday that it will take the Estonian Shipping company to the bourse if its consortium wins a privatisation bid.
Nomura plans to take the company to the in a couple of years, which enables all Estonian investors to invest in its shares, Claus Mansfeldt, Nomura Baltic division director, added in a statement.
Nomura is in a consortium called Arbonale with Talinvest, Hansa Investments, N-Terminaal, Norwegian shipping company Navigator and Hong Kong shipping company Jinhui Shipping and Transportation Ltd.
Mansfeldt also said it was important for Estonian Shipping to get an international credit rating, which would help it get additional capital and more favourable conditions.
The consortium is competing with ESCO Holding to privatise 70 percent of shares in Estonian Shipping Company.

ESCO was formed by Norwegian Tschudi & Eitzen, Uhisinvesteeringud, part of Uhispank , U.S. Stanton Capital Corporation, Baltic Cresco, the current management of Estonian shipping company and food company EPEKS.
